ordering: Buffer eligible fragmented uploads (at most 4 MiB) until all bytes arrive. conclusion: Complete-overwrite elision exercised in combat; movement retained about one readback per latch. No clean FPS comparison. Buffered version not promoted; its extra complexity has no demonstrated gameplay benefit over the narrower candidate.
